title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Onsite Visit Billing
content:
An onsite business-hours visit on a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket whose labor is settled by invoice is billed as an onsite visit charge, trip charge included, on the client's monthly invoice.

**Scope.** For the onsite business-hours labor of the agreement's most recently resolved ticket whose labor class is onsite business-hours and whose labor route is invoice, when that visit is wholly billable (no included onsite minutes of its month remain for it) on a tier whose onsite trip charge is above zero, and only for that visit, the labor amount is set by the onsite visit schedule. The labor of the agreement's most recently resolved remote after-hours ticket whose labor route is invoice follows the after-hours remote schedule; a partly included visit stays under the base rule (only the excess is billable and the onsite minimum does not apply to that excess); and every other labor amount remains under the base rule: billable minutes divided by 60, multiplied by the remote or onsite hourly rate, multiplied by the after-hours multiplier for after-hours labor, rounded half up to the cent, plus the onsite trip charge for each onsite visit that is wholly billable.

**Billing.** The charge is billed on the next monthly invoice after the resolution, under the month the work was performed.

## Invocation: `post_onsite_visit_labor_c7936621`

**Capability.** Bills the onsite business-hours visit of one resolved service desk ticket on a ClearPath invoice: one onsite business-hours labor charge for the visit, including any trip charge, is posted onto the named monthly invoice, recording the billable minutes and the amount, and the amount is added to what the client owes on the agreement. On success the billing ledger shows the visit line on that invoice and the agreement balance increases.

**How it is invoked.** `post_onsite_visit_labor_c7936621` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `managed_agreement_id` | the reference number of the ClearPath agreement the ticket is logged under, as returned by the agreement lookup for the verified client | identifier |
| `ticket_number` | the service desk ticket the visit was made on, exactly as shown in the ticket history | SB- followed by 7 digits |
| `invoice_number` | the monthly invoice the charge is billed on, exactly as shown on the billing ledger | INV- followed by 6 digits |
| `billing_period` | the month the visit was made | YYYY-MM (calendar month, US Eastern) |
| `billable_minutes` | the minutes billed for the visit | integer minutes |
| `amount_usd` | the visit amount in US dollars including any trip charge | positive decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation string with the ticket number, the invoice number, the service month (YYYY-MM), the billable minutes, the amount in US dollars with 2 decimals and the agreement's new balance due in US dollars with 2 decimals; it begins with "Onsite visit labor posted" when the charge is on the ledger.
